title: Query Invalidation
description: Learn how to invalidate and refetch queries after mutations.

data.text: **Query invalidation** marks cached data as stale and triggers a refetch. This ensures your UI shows fresh data after mutations.

data.title: Invalidation
Automatic Invalidation
data.text: Consider using @tanstack/query-axios-adapter or similar libraries that handle invalidation automatically based on HTTP methods.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Can invalidate specific or all queries
data.takeaway: Invalidation keeps data fresh after mutations.
